description: First-load JavaScript budgets per page, gzip, in kB of 1,000 bytes (BLUEPRINT §11.4). A page not named here gets defaultKb. Checked by pnpm --filter web js-budget after pnpm build; how it measures is in scripts/js-budget.ts.
